sources.label: Blockhead: Revolut launches EURR, issued by Bridge Building S.A. under CSSF

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Verified on-chain rather than inferred: EURR at 0x8e9c32a536ab623a2e0e9961bce6f5fe7504e084 is a minimal ERC-1967 proxy delegating to implementation 0xb6de5eabb9ffaf853235a6b96886fb87f73400a8, whose bytecode exposes pause/paused, mint, owner, and OpenZeppelin AccessControl role administration (hasRole, grantRole). No USDT/USDC-style isBlacklisted or blacklist selector is present, so per-address freezing is not exposed as a dedicated entry point, but the issuer can halt all transfers via pause and can introduce arbitrary freeze or seize logic through a proxy upgrade. Bridge Building S.A. issues under a Luxembourg EMI licence and MiCA authorisation from the CSSF, a regime that requires issuers to operate a compliance program capable of freezing and reissuing tokens.
